sam_sm: CarterSec sent a locked list for the SIG tomorrow - they want: confirmation of key custody, exact wording on non-exportability, a rotation policy line, and a 1-line POC they can run during the call. Can sec confirm what we can hand them quickly?
imelda_security: We can hand: 1) single-line custody: Redwood-managed CMKs (default) or BYOK where customer keeps keys in their cloud/HSM; 2) non-exportability: HSM-backed CMKs (AWS CloudHSM, Azure Dedicated HSM, Thales via Private adapter) are non-exportable by design; 3) rotation defaults: Redwood-managed high-security tenants = 90d, standard = 365d, BYOK = customer-controlled; 4) redacted audit example and one CLI smoke test.

carter_cust: For the "BYOK customer-controlled" flow - do you ever retain plaintext? We need a clear sentence.
imelda_security: No. If customer imports key material into their KMS or uses an HSM we do not have access to plaintext or raw key material. We'll include the legal carve: "Redwood does not hold or escrow customer key material for BYOK/imported keys."

oliver_sre: CLI smoke test (single line) we can give to run live: `aws kms generate-data-key --key-id alias/RedwoodPOC --key-spec AES_256 --query CiphertextBlob --output text | base64 --decode > ct.bin && aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://ct.bin --query Plaintext --output text | base64 --decode > pt.bin`

toni_platform: Audit sample (redacted) we'll attach as single-line JSON for their vendor CSV mapping: `{ "eventTime": "2025-09-01T14:02:11Z", "eventName": "Decrypt", "principal": "arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/RedwoodPOCRole", "keyId": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:REDACTED:key/abcd-ef01", "result": "Success" }`

sam_sm: Great. Action: @imelda_security to drop one-pager + attestation PDFs; @oliver_sre to include the single-line CLI and short grant steps; I'll ship everything to Carter by 10:00 AM. Carter, ok?

carter_cust: OK thanks, that should cover the vendor review checklist. We'll run the CLI live if time permits. :thumbsup:
